subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution
text:
Hi Amol,
Thank you for your interest.
For detailed CENTEC-based product information(specifications and
datasheets), we usually provide them directly to partners via email, as we
continuously update our offerings.
To better understand your needs:
1. Are you working on a project or developing your own brand?
2. Is this regarding MII compliance, or just a regular import?
We'd be happy to discuss further and explore how we can support your plans.
Thank you.
note: SA-023 Impulse CCTV（印度，Amol Kumar）：Elsa 2026-01-08 回 CENTEC 询问——没给规格书，反问「项目还是自有品牌 / 是否 MII 合规」，附 8C48XF 图
